question: Should OpenClaw add first-party per-agent backup, restore, and clone commands now, and what credential/session portability policy should those commands enforce?
rationale: The feature is not a mechanical extension of `backup create`; it defines how sensitive persisted state is copied, rewritten, or excluded during restore and clone operations.

options.title: Sponsor a first-party design
options.body: Define the archive manifest, credential portability, transcript policy, overwrite/rollback behavior, and tests before implementation.

options.title: Fold into broader backup work
options.body: Keep this issue open but make the broader backup/restore effort or encrypted snapshot PR own the shared restore format before per-agent clone lands.

options.title: Decline core clone for now
options.body: Document manual recovery guidance and leave per-agent clone tooling outside core until a safer product contract is ready.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a first-party design
recommendation.body: Define the archive manifest, credential portability, transcript policy, overwrite/rollback behavior, and tests before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest recent routing signal for the current backup implementation and review policy surface.
